rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something defective, unreliable, or not acceptable.

example.english: This report is faulty and cannot be sent to the client.
example.traditional: 呢份報告有問題，唔可以交畀客。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 man6 tai4 m4 ho2 ji5 gaau1 bei2 haak3

rows.note: Use this especially for a physical object, machine, or system that is broken or not working.

example.english: The photocopier is faulty and cannot print documents.
example.traditional: 部影印機壞咗，印唔到文件。
example.jyutping: bou6 jing2 jan3 gei1 waai6 zo2 jan3 m4 dou3 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this when something is functioning or behaving abnormally rather than simply being broken.

example.english: The sensor is faulty, working properly only some of the time.
example.traditional: 個感應器反應唔正常，一時得一時唔得。
example.jyutping: go3 gam2 jing3 hei3 faan2 jing3 m4 zing3 soeng4 jat1 si4 dak1 jat1 si4 m4 dak1
